name: egr
description: Use when EGR codes are stored (P0400-P0409), or a diesel smokes black, idles rough or lacks power at low rpm.
instructions: Call read_dtcs, then detail EGR codes with fault_codes (read_dtcs_detail).
Open extended_data when it is offered: the EGR valve position tells a stuck valve. read_live {"pids":["0110","010C","010B"],"seconds":10} at idle shows MAF and MAP.
There is no output test in this phase: the app does not move the EGR valve; say a workshop can run the EGR output test.
Also run boost and dpf_regen when they are offered: a clogged EGR adds soot, and a boost leak looks like an EGR fault.
interpret: EGR stuck open: rough idle, black smoke and low power at low rpm; MAF at idle lower than usual (exhaust gas replaces fresh air).
EGR stuck closed: little effect on driving, sometimes P0401 (insufficient flow).
P0401 (insufficient flow): a clogged valve or cooler; P0403 (circuit): the actuator wiring or the valve motor.
Short trips clog the EGR and the DPF together.

golf-plus-2009-20tdi: The extended data includes the EGR valve position; this DID is not yet confirmed on the car, so treat it as indicative.
